title: Key West 2-Hour Guided Jet Ski Island Tour – 28-Mile Full Lap
includes: Drivers cannot be under 16 years of age (not included)
Riders cannot be under 6 years of age (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
1 Person/Driver per Booking; Passengers ride free.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This is the only full two-hour guided jet ski tour in Key West. The 28-mile island lap provides approximately 30 minutes more riding time than a typical 90-minute tour, allowing for a more complete route and several scenic stops when conditions permit. Ride a stable Yamaha WaveRunner VX while an experienced local guide manages the route according to tides, weather, marine traffic, and safety conditions. Shared and private options may be available, with groups limited to a maximum of six jet skis.
